visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: the gap between the head and the body is now exactly 4 units of ink (the head's bottom (24,18) is 8 above the body's flat top at y26 on centerlines, was 9) and the checker certifies it. Legs and body are otherwise as reviewed.
omissions: To make the exact 4-unit gap certifiable, the head is four cardinal quarter arcs, so both antennae now leave the head's top point (24,8) instead of its upper sides, and the body top is a short flat segment.
